description: The bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the popularity of various large language models (LLMs) across three different knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis, labeled "Popularity," is scaled from 20 to 220, with the data points for each LLM represented by distinct bar types. The chart compares six models: Llama3 (blue, diagonal stripes), Qwen2 (red, diagonal stripes), ChatGPT (yellow, horizontal stripes), Acc-0 & GT Ans (black, cross-hatch), Acc-0 & Gene Ans (black, diagonal stripes), and Acc-1 & GT Ans (white, outlined). For the "Movies" and "Songs" categories, the bars are relatively low, with the tallest bar in each category being Llama3, reaching a popularity of approximately 60. In contrast, the "Basketball" category shows significantly higher popularity for all models. Here, the bars are much taller, with Qwen2 reaching the highest popularity of approximately 210, followed by Llama3 at about 170, and ChatGPT at around 135. The other three categories, representing different answer accuracy conditions, are consistently lower, with the highest bar (Acc-0 & GT Ans) in the Basketball category reaching approximately 100. The chart's structure clearly shows that the popularity of LLMs is heavily influenced by the subject matter, with basketball-related knowledge being the most popular across all models.
